question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 42. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 16 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average be 16 runs.

Deviation of the first 23 matches = 42 − 16 = +26

Total net deviation = 23 × 26 = +598

Change in average for all 33 matches = +598 ÷ 33 = +18.1212...

Combined average = 16 + 18.12 = 34.12

**∴ The correct answer is 34.12 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs scored in the first 23 matches = 42

Average runs scored in the next 10 matches = 16

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = (Total sum of all items) ÷ (Total number of items)
